title: Trump Wins a Second, Non-Consecutive Term
dek: Donald Trump carries all seven swing states, 312 electoral votes and the popular vote; Kamala Harris concedes at Howard University.
body: Trump took 49.8% of the popular vote to Harris’s 48.3%. Only Grover Cleveland, in 1892, had won non-consecutive terms before.

panels.label: Trump Says
panels.text: Trump says “America has given us an unprecedented and powerful mandate.”

panels.label: Harris Says
panels.text: Harris says she concedes the election but does “not concede the fight that fueled this campaign.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side calls the result a mandate, the other a lost round in a longer fight; at stake is how much power a 49.8% win confers.
